report:
Reviewed all requirements of meta.reviews.input_fragments, associated review.rs source and all four complete associated tests. This is source inspection; no behavior tests were executed, and central suite results are separate evidence.

inventory creates claim, whole implementation-file and complete semantic test fragments in the single ReviewInput.fragments vector, each using InputFragment path/selector/source_lines. capture_read resolves a declared dependency with select, appends that same InputFragment representation, persists the expanded input and only then returns its text. There is no alternate helper-context format exempt from freshness. input_errors compares current initial fragments as an ordered prefix, then reselects every appended fragment and compares exact joined contents; missing/ambiguous selectors and changed text are errors. record invokes that validation before writing output and does not rewrite saved input to conceal stale context. Captured correspondence and fixture sources explain initial selection; captured check wiring applies the same validation after recording.

Dependency completeness is explicitly reviewer-declared, not an automatic audit of arbitrary tool reads. The captured review skill requires capture of additional source dependencies before using them, including helpers and surrounding context, and warns coordinators against uncaptured context. PROMPT likewise requires following and capturing helpers. This is the claim's stated responsibility allocation: availability of initial claim/tests does not excuse undeclared extra context. Ordered coordinator instruction text is stored separately as instructions; coordinator-supplied source context must still be captured as fragments.

initial_context_preserves_instructions_and_exact_uniform_fragments asserts exact saved/returned input, prompt/instructions and claim/implementation/test paths/selectors/reconstructed text, including semantic tests rather than whole test files. input_keeps_complete_association_metadata_and_appends_context_in_one_collection checks all metadata, an extra helper read's exact text, unchanged association vectors and initial-fragment prefix, precisely one appended fragment and the single schema collection. whole_files_and_ranges_preserve_exact_line_endings_and_detect_selected_edits verifies extra range/whole-file reads with mixed line endings, invalid-range rejection, retained validity for unselected edits, failure for selected edits, repeated capture equality and terminal-newline freshness. invalid_reports_and_stale_inputs_never_complete_an_active_review rejects recording before start and malformed reports, then mutates an initial implementation source and asserts failed recording preserves input bytes and leaves the gate invalid; it also checks a concrete changes-requested report can be recorded without passing the gate. Captured Fixture/TEST helpers perform real workspace/read/write/review operations, with substantive assertions in the test bodies.

These tests jointly establish uniform initial/later context and shared exact freshness handling. Reviewer declaration remains a process obligation, not falsely claimed automated source-read detection. No TODO or N/A entries are associated with this anchor. No concrete defect or additional necessary edit was found; no source changes are requested.
